simple.meaning: שֵׁבֶט (shêbeṭ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a scion , i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 190 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 49:10. Its contexts include family, altar, mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֵׁבֶט (H7626).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שֵׁבֶט (shêbeṭ) / H7626 is traced through Genesis 49:10, Genesis 49:16, Genesis 49:28, Exodus 21:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.
